title: Eliminar pista generada por codigo: autos solo en parts llamados pista
request: Eliminar la pista que genera el codigo (workspace.TrafficPaths) y hacer que el part llamado pista sea el unico lugar donde aparecen autos. Si aparece otro part llamado pista, tambien recibe trafico automaticamente.

operations.source:
--============================================================
-- PISTA SERVICE · los autos SOLO aparecen en parts llamados 'pista'
-- 1) Elimina la pista generada por codigo (workspace.TrafficPaths)
-- 2) Cada part llamado 'pista' (actual o futuro) recibe trafico
--============================================================
local Workspace = game:GetService('Workspace')
local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local ServerScriptService = game:GetService('ServerScriptService')
local Debris = game:GetService('Debris')

local CAR_SPEED = 30
local CAR_LIFE = 22
local SPAWN_EVERY = 5
local OFF_TRACK_LIMIT = 40

---------------- servicios (require perezoso, no rompe si cambian) ----------------
local EntitySpawner
local HazardService
local DeliveryService
do
  local folder = ServerScriptService:WaitForChild('DeliveryServer', 10)
  if folder then
    local ok1, m1 = pcall(function() return require(folder:WaitForChild('EntitySpawner', 10)) end)
    if ok1 and type(m1) == 'table' then EntitySpawner = m1 end
    local ok2, m2 = pcall(function() return require(folder:WaitForChild('HazardService', 10)) end)
    if ok2 and type(m2) == 'table' then HazardService = m2 end
    local ok3, m3 = pcall(function() return require(folder:WaitForChild('DeliveryService', 10)) end)
    if ok3 and type(m3) == 'table' then DeliveryService = m3 end
  end
end

---------------- 1) eliminar la pista generada por codigo ----------------
local city = Workspace:WaitForChild('DeliveryCity', 15)
if city then
  task.wait(1.2) -- dejar que MapBuilder termine de construir
end
local generated = Workspace:FindFirstChild('TrafficPaths')
if generated then
  generated:Destroy()
  print('[PistaService] pista generada por codigo eliminada (TrafficPaths)')
else
  print('[PistaService] no habia pista generada (TrafficPaths)')
end

---------------- 2) registrar parts llamados 'pista' (actuales y futuros) ----------------
local tracks = {} -- [part] = true

local function isTrack(inst)
  return inst:IsA('BasePart') and string.lower(inst.Name) == 'pista'
end

local function scanTracks()
  local stack = { Workspace }
  while #stack > 0 do
    local inst = table.remove(stack)
    for _, child in ipairs(inst:GetChildren()) do
      if isTrack(child) then
        if not tracks[child] then
          tracks[child] = true
          child:SetAttribute('PistaTrack', true)
          print('[PistaService] pista registrada: ' .. child:GetFullName())
        end
      end
      table.insert(stack, child)
    end
  end
end

local function pruneTracks()
  for part in pairs(tracks) do
    if not part.Parent then
      tracks[part] = nil
    end
  end
end

---------------- geometria de la pista ----------------
local function trackAxis(part)
  local size = part.Size
  local cf = part.CFrame
  local half, dir
  if size.X >= size.Z then
    half = size.X / 2
    dir = cf.RightVector
  else
    half = size.Z / 2
    dir = cf.LookVector
  end
  return cf.Position, dir, math.max(half - 2, 2)
end

---------------- crear un auto en una pista ----------------
local function spawnCarOn(part)
  local center, dir, half = trackAxis(part)
  local t = math.random() * 2 - 1
  local pos = center + dir * (half * t)
  local a = center - dir * half
  local b = center + dir * half
  local car = EntitySpawner.Spawn('TrafficCar', {
    WaypointA = a,
    WaypointB = b,
    Speed = CAR_SPEED,
    LifeTime = CAR_LIFE,
  }, CFrame.new(pos))
  car:GetAttributeChangedSignal('CaughtTick'):Connect(function()
    local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(car:GetAttribute('CaughtUserId') or 0)
    if plr and car.PrimaryPart then
      if HazardService then pcall(HazardService.Trip, plr, car.PrimaryPart.Position) end
      if DeliveryService then pcall(DeliveryService.DropPackage, plr, 'car') end
    end
  end)
  Debris:AddItem(car, CAR_LIFE)
end

local function pickTrack()
  pruneTracks()
  local list = {}
  for part in pairs(tracks) do
    table.insert(list, part)
  end
  if #list == 0 then return nil end
  return list[math.random(#list)]
end

---------------- limpieza: autos fuera de pista se eliminan ----------------
local function cleanupOffTrack()
  for _, car in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
    if car.Name == 'TrafficCar' and car:IsA('Model') then
      local pp = car.PrimaryPart or car:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('BasePart', true)
      if pp then
        local near = false
        for part in pairs(tracks) do
          if part.Parent and (pp.Position - part.Position).Magnitude < OFF_TRACK_LIMIT then
            near = true
            break
          end
        end
        if not near then
          car:Destroy()
        end
      end
    end
  end
end

---------------- bucle de trafico: autos solo en pistas ----------------
task.spawn(function()
  while true do
    task.wait(SPAWN_EVERY)
    scanTracks()
    cleanupOffTrack()
    local part = pickTrack()
    if part and EntitySpawner then
      local ok, err = pcall(spawnCarOn, part)
      if not ok then
        warn('[PistaService] error al crear auto: ' .. tostring(err))
      end
    end
  end
end)

scanTracks()
print('[PistaService] listo · autos solo en parts llamados pista')
